visual_brief.subject: A complete speech-recognition, local-language-model and speech-synthesis loop stays on the device
verified_context: Google added on-device ASR and TTS to AI Edge Gallery for offline voice applications.
The Android path uses system speech models while MediaPipe Tasks and LiteRT support cross-platform open-weight bundles alongside local SLMs.
Google publishes first-party latency and speed figures that remain device- and language-dependent.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: An acoustic signal enters a contained local chamber, changes form and leaves without crossing the device boundary.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A folded paper acoustic tunnel sits entirely inside a charcoal capsule, transforming sage input waves into terracotta output waves.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant but the waveform marks and three compartments read closer to product iconography.
candidate_notes.B: Selected. The contained folded tunnel and two restrained sound ribbons show local transformation with strong mobile-crop resilience.
candidate_notes.C: Rejected at the constitutional gate because the phone and waveform-emblem cartridges imitate a product interface.

crop_review.article_desktop: The complete metaphor and separation boundaries remain visible in the wide 1600×900 hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop retains the dominant chamber, gate or transformation and its terracotta signal.
crop_review.thumbnail: The physical silhouette remains distinct at 320px without relying on fine texture.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate matches the golden references in warm paper field, restrained charcoal/teal mass, sparse terracotta signal, tactile materiality and confident negative space while keeping a story-specific silhouette.
